ValidationRule.description: Only allow B2B Sales team to update the status of deposit record to Deposit Reviewed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status__c) && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Deposit Reviewed") && NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "B2B")) && NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "System Admin"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deposit can only be reviewed by B2B Sales Team
